groups.merge_rationale: One reviewer independently rediscovered the same historical defect; retain its stable finding ID and both evidence sources.

merged_text.title: Invalid numeric identifiers return a server error.
merged_text.body: An invalid identifier reaches int() without error handling. The resulting ValueError escapes the endpoint and returns HTTP 500 instead of the required HTTP 400.

evidence.explanation: The new endpoint converts untrusted text with int() without handling ValueError.
